text:
Priya Nair: Quick idea — micro-influencer seed + partner reposts for the May webinar. Goal: boost signups + create 2 organic threads we can amplify. Need list of targets, short DM templates, and an embargo plan.
Diego Morales: Love it. Suggest 5 X creators (dev infra + MLops focus) and 3 LinkedIn authors (platform/product). I can draft target list by EOD.
Harper Cole: I'll write 2 DM templates: (1) short invite + ask for RT, (2) co-host ask (offer guest slot). ETA tomorrow morning.
Eliot Park: Can we run a small paid boost on the top-performing influencer post for 48h? Budget ask: $800. KPI target: CPL <$30.
Kirsten Voss: For assets — we need 1 hero (1200x675), 1 carousel for LinkedIn (1080x1080 3-up), and two 15s clips. Also want the benchmark callout: "30% lower per-token cost in retrieval workflows" (≤10 words).
Priya Nair: Good. Let's avoid repeating the exact bench phrasing we used in other promos. Use: "30% lower per-token cost in retrieval workflows" for the hero line.
Diego Morales: Target list draft: @matt_devops, @sarah_ml, @ops_oncall, @ai_infra. Will DM contacts and add outreach status in the spreadsheet. Link: https://drive.redwood/marketing/influencer-seed.xlsx
Harper Cole: DM templates attached in thread (short + co-host). Short DM preview: "Hey — we're running a practical demo on inference economics May 6. Would you mind a quick RT? We'll send assets + an exclusive stat."
Eliot Park: Paid boost OK from my channel. Approving $800. Will set geo-focus: US + Canada, org size 50–500.
Kirsten Voss: Uploading image proofs: https://drive.redwood/marketing/hero_v2.png and clips: https://drive.redwood/marketing/clip_15s_v1.mp4 :camera_with_flash:
Priya Nair: Scheduling plan: influencer DMs go out Mon Apr 27, follow-up DM 48h later. Partner reposts scheduled for May 5 (embargo lift at 10am PT). Organic X-thread goes live May 6 at 11am PT. LinkedIn carousel at 9am PT.
Priya Nair: UTM & tracking — use campaign=webinar_may6_infl and source=influencer. Add param for "influencer_handle" when possible. Example: 
https://redwood.ai/rsvp?utm_source=influencer&utm_campaign=webinar_may6_infl&utm_term=@matt_devops
Diego Morales: I'll wire the spreadsheet to HubSpot so each row creates a lead with the handle tag. Also adding a custom field "influencer_origin" for routing.
Harper Cole: For community follow-up: draft 1st-touch DM (thank you + link to recording), 2nd-touch (7 days: short case study + invite to trial).
Eliot Park: Monitoring/windowing: Priya to own AM drop window + first 3 hours. Diego will monitor engagement 3–6pm PT and escalate warm replies to SDRs. We'll capture top 20 engagers.
Kirsten Voss: Creative note: hero CTA should be "See the demo + benchmarks" (short). Also mock two color options, will upload variants.
Priya Nair: One risk callout: don't push raw benchmark numbers in DMs unless influencer okays it. We'll include the short context line: "internal tests on retrieval-heavy workloads" in the press kit.
schedule-bot: Slots checked — May 6, 11:00 PT reserved for #marketing organic thread. Reminder set 24h prior and 1h prior.
Priya Nair: Recap/timeline: Diego target list EOD; Harper DM templates tomorrow AM; Kirsten assets EOD Wed; Eliot sets paid boost; HubSpot mapping done by Thurs. We'll use this thread for updates and post final influencer list here. Thanks :sparkles:
